CustomField.label: Offering
CustomField.description: Native lookup to the GTM_Instrument_Definition__c record (one per offering, per docs/architecture/gtm-instrument-schema.md section 2.1) this submission was scored against, alongside the existing Offering_Key__c text field kept for backward query compatibility during the rebuild transition (ADR-0009's existing text-key convention). Populated server-side, best-effort, by matching the resolved offering key to an Active GTM_Instrument_Definition__c row -- null whenever that offering has not yet been authored on the new schema (every offering starts unmigrated per gtm-instrument-schema.md section 7). Never client-supplied.
